facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but under CEMAC exchange control; repatriate earnings through your bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: No: residents can't open foreign-currency accounts locally; declare accounts abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register through the VUE one-stop shop; the simplest form for individuals isn't confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: Reportedly a NIF from the tax administration; not confirmed.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents are taxed on worldwide income.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT; threshold and export rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 1/2016 on personal data; its authority isn't operational yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.

watch_out.text: Declare any accounts you hold abroad to the BEAC.
